findings.summary: B4 candidate (pre-registration approved 2026-11-09). NOT promoted (decision N-D4); the promoted run of the tier is unchanged. Distillation teacher passed on the command line (docs/audit/b4/b4_pipeline.sh); train_model does not record it in run_metadata.json (AI-N37). UPDATE 2026-11-15: promoted for the PC tier by Luciano's decision R-D3 after the confirmatory B4c evaluation passed (it replaces the 2026-11-04 run). Not in main or any release until Luciano's OK.

Does NOT meet the pre-registered B4 criterion: the only failing check is |delta abstention| <= 5 pt on E4 (held-out 50/70 rad/s): abstention 0.004 vs 0.167 for the promoted run (-16.3 pt). Every other check passes: E1 macro-F1 0.939 (promoted 0.885), E3 0.984 (0.982), E4 0.994 (0.684), low-speed min recall 0.972. UPDATE 2026-11-15: resolved by B4c (pre-registered before its data, 150 new low-speed runs, one-sided abstention rule with a selective-risk bound): PASSES every criterion (macro-F1 0.994 vs 0.661; selective risk 0.004 vs 0.275).
Trained and evaluated only on simulated data (dc_perm_ex_v2, converter dcm_exact, 10 kHz). No measured drive data; not run on its target hardware.

ball/cage: synthetic-only, uncalibrated amplitude. The ball and cage classes were trained on simulated faults whose mechanical amplitude (CALIBRATED_MECHANICAL_SEVERITY in datagen/scenario.py) is a placeholder: KAt has no clean single-defect code for these faults, so it cannot be calibrated without real data.
Weakest point on E4c (simulated, held-out low speed): cage recall 0.89 at 45 rad/s (8 cage windows read as normal), below the 50 rad/s held out in B4. All other classes >= 0.97 at 45-70 rad/s.

The abstention rule was changed AFTER seeing B4's E4 result (two-sided |delta| <= 5 pt -> one-sided with a selective-risk bound). Because of that it was confirmed on new data (E4c, 150 runs, seeds 100001-100150) pre-registered before generation; E4 itself no longer counts as an independent test of the new rule.
Everything about this run is simulated: trained and evaluated on dc_perm_ex_v2 simulations only; no measured drive data; not run on its target hardware; no board measurement of any kind.
